background: Born and raised in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn, by Senegalese parents; his grandfather was a Sufi teacher who welcomed travelers with attaya tea poured three times.
regionalHistory: His parents carried memories of Dakar's coastline, griots' songs, and a family of patient fishermen into their Brooklyn home.
culturalBaseline: Sufi warmth; remembrance (dhikr) and hospitality are one and the same to him.
sensitivities: Africa treated as a single place
